items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And then Charles Fambrough on bass... And this one you had George Adams, Joe Ford, Charles Fambrough, and Sonship.

ctx.x: And then Charles Fambrough on bass, so you keep expanding, now you’ve got a broadened front line coming out of this. And then when we get to Inner Voices, now this one also is a departure so, composed and arranged by McCoy Tyner plus horns and voices, so what was the inspiration for this project?
Is there a lot of voices on there? Inner Voices. Yeah I guess that’s why I named it like that.
